title: CMN Eases Resource Use for Rural Debt Renegotiation
seoTitle: CMN Eases Resource Use for Debt Renegotiation
subtitle: New Measure Offers Rural Producers More Flexible Debt Renegotiation
excerpt: As of late July, the National Monetary Council (CMN) authorizes the use of funds for rural debt renegotiation, offering more flexible conditions to producers.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Effective since late July, the special debt renegotiation for rural producers will be facilitated by the National Monetary Council (CMN), which has relaxed the rules for resource allocation for this purpose.

This adjustment enables farmers to access more favorable terms when renegotiating their financial obligations, thereby expanding payment options.

With information from Agência Brasil.
